paras.p: AI at Home gives you the words to paste into the chat app you already use. Back comes a call plan: who to ask for, your first sentence, and the lowest price you'll accept. The company can still say no, and you'll have made the call.
The guide does the same for the week's dinners, a check engine light and a trip.

data.note: [[refund]]: email elvin@elvinpeters.com within [[refund_days]] for a full refund.

get.line: What comes with it: the Toolkit, seven files you can edit, and the Companion Library, which opens online from your library page.
Three bonuses: The 7-Day AI Workbook, Everything AI 2026 and The 12 Commandments to Make AI Obey.
